metadata.description: Internal Claude Code plugins for the Sociaaal LLC team. Creative ops, research, and production automation for our consumer AI app portfolio.

plugins.name: winner-agent
plugins.description: Produces editor-ready video creative packages for any of our 17 Sociaaal apps. Researches trends across TikTok / Meta / Instagram via the operator's logged-in Chrome. Reads past creatives from Drive + per-app research dossier. Produces exactly 5 concepts × 9 hook variations per run (45 deliverables). Pauses at 4 human-in-the-loop checkpoints (research review, concept approval, asset budget, final review) so you stay in control. Generates AI assets via Higgsfield.
